name: Digital Veterinary Electrocardiograph
description: High-precision 3-channel ECG monitor specifically calibrated for small and large animals. Features advanced filters for muscle tremor artifact reduction.

name: Multiparameter Patient Monitor
description: Real-time vital signs tracking system including SpO2, NIBP, pulse rate, ECG, and temperature. Designed with sensitive alarm thresholds for anesthesia monitoring.

name: Veterinary Infusion Pump
description: Advanced volumetric infusion pump with precise flow rate control for accurate intravenous fluid and medication administration. Compatible with micro and macro veterinary sets.

name: Portable Veterinary Ultrasound Scanner
description: Compact ultrasound machine equipped with interchangeable linear, convex, and micro-convex probes. Ideal for abdominal scanning and pregnancy checking in pets.

name: Precision Veterinary Electrosurgical Unit
description: High-frequency surgical generator with monopolar and bipolar modes. Provides clean cuts and rapid coagulation to minimize bleeding in delicate interventions.

name: Dental Scaler & Polishing Unit
description: Ultrasonic scaler unit designed for fast and safe plaque removal. Features adjustable power levels and an automatic water spray system to prevent thermal damage.

name: Veterinary Anesthesia Machine
description: Compact isoflurane vaporizing system with precise oxygen flowmeter. Features a specialized rebreathing circuit suitable for pediatric kittens and large breeds.

name: Digital Refractometer & Otoscope Kit
description: Premium diagnosis pack including a fiber-optic otoscope with specialized veterinary specula and a digital refractometer for precise urine specific gravity analysis.

name: Veterinary Centrifuge Machine
description: High-speed blood and urine plasma separation unit. Features a digital timer, step-less speed regulation, and a safety lid-lock system for busy clinical labs.

name: Automated Hematology Analyzer
description: Provides 3-part differentiation of WBC, RBC, and platelets. Delivers highly accurate blood count results for multiple animal profiles in less than two minutes.

name: Veterinary Operating Table
description: Heavy-duty stainless steel V-top surgery table with electric lift motor, adjustable tilt angles, and built-in drain channel for fluid management.

name: Digital Veterinary X-Ray Sensor
description: High-resolution intraoral and general digital dental radiography sensor. Provides immediate image rendering to minimize pet anesthesia exposure time.

name: Veterinary ICU Incubator
description: Thermostatic recovery chamber with integrated humidification and oxygen delivery ports. Provides a safe and warm environment for critical newborns and postoperative pets.

name: Blood Pressure Monitor VET
description: Non-invasive oscillometric blood pressure system specifically optimized for steady and reliable measurements on small, awake companion animals.

name: Veterinary Laryngoscope Set
description: Fiber-optic illumination intubation set with multiple curved and straight blades designed to navigate diverse exotic and domestic throat structures.
